name: home-assistant-readonly
description: Home Assistant WebSocket API: read-only commands only (states, config, registries, dashboards).
card_text: Home Assistant, read-only: the client may only send a fixed list of read commands (states, configuration, registries, dashboards, logs); every other command is refused.
risk_notes: Only the listed read message types may be sent; the credential-minting commands are also blocked by name.
The client still sees everything the signed-in user can read, including entity states and attributes.
render_template evaluates a template on the server; it can read state but cannot call services.
subscribe_events lets the client watch any event type.
